Rotate into high-beta small caps with earnings momentum, but trim exposure to US-listed financials where rate-cut repricing caps upside. Maintain overweight on ID financials, targeting 8-12% alpha over 3 months.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: US solar and storage names are re-rating on falling rate expectations and IRA implementation clarity, creating durable upside for inverter and residential installers through 2025.
Indonesia's EV value chain is structurally accelerating via nickel downstreaming and domestic content rules, making VKTR and TOBA core beneficiaries of local manufacturing mandates.
Power utilities (NRG, CEG) are gaining defensive bid as AI-driven electricity demand forecasts tighten supply, supporting long-term contracted cash flows despite near-term volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy pullbacks in US-listed solar/energy storage names (SEDG, ENPH, RUN) and Indonesia EV/battery plays (VKTR, TOBA) on strength; sector breadth is healthy with normal signals and US leadership. sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: IDR depreciation is a durable tailwind for FMCG exporters and agri-processors (BWPT, EL, PGUN), boosting rupiah-denominated margins and competitiveness.
Middle-class consumption resilience is bifurcating: premium/health-oriented brands (COIN, JARR) outperform mass-market staples, forcing portfolio tilt toward niche leaders.
M&A and consolidation in Indonesian consumer space is accelerating, with small caps (BRRC, AGAR) re-rating on acquisition premiums and distribution synergies.
sectors.ai: Buy selective consumer names with hard earnings catalysts: BRRC, COIN, and JARR are leading on volume-driven repricing, not beta. Favor exporters (BWPT, EL) on IDR weakness and palm/agri tailwinds; trim pure domestic staples without pricing power. Rotate into mid-caps showing 20%+ moves on real fundamentals, avoid chasing FOLK/AGAR without follow-through.

Near-term catalyst: Q3 volume data and fuel subsidy adjustments.
